gen_risks.description: Delays in project implementation due to overloaded FM staff
gen_risks.mitigation: Appoint adequate FM staff, including government officers and consultants, within three months of project signing

gen_risks.description: Delays in receiving technical inputs for procurement
gen_risks.mitigation: Enhance coordination between implementing departments to expedite acquisition of technical inputs

gen_risks.description: Governance risks, including corrupt practices in procurement
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement enhanced disclosure of procurement information and establish a procurement complaint handling mechanism

gen_risks.description: Inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide targeted contract management training to the project's procurement team

gen_risks.description: Delays in internal clearance from procurement review committee
gen_risks.mitigation: Assign a focal person to ensure effective coordination within technical departments and across ministries

gen_risks.description: Climate-related hazards, including floods, extreme heat, and tropical cyclones
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate climate-resilient design standards in new infrastructure, including elevated foundations and energy-efficient systems

gen_risks.description: Limited access to affordable and quality childcare services
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop sustainable early childcare services, including construction of childcare centers and provision of training and equipment

gen_risks.description: Insufficient teacher capacity to effectively fulfill their roles
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide teacher training and mentoring support, including targeted instruction and coaching

gen_risks.description: Shortages of key inputs, including textbooks and infrastructure deficiencies
gen_risks.mitigation: Procure and distribute teaching and learning materials, including textbooks and digital tools

gen_risks.description: Poor human resources management, impeding efficient utilization of allocated resources
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a functioning education staff management system, including modernization of HRMIS

gen_risks.description: Gender disparities in employment quality and limited access to formal, better-paid, and secure forms of employment for women
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide childcare options for women working in factories and track the percentage of women employed or reemployed as a result of these interventions

gen_risks.description: GBV prevalence in the education sector, particularly among vulnerable populations
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct GBV-related teacher training programs and integrate GBV programs into project design

gen_risks.description: Limited data on GBV prevalence, particularly among primary school-aged children
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct research and data collection on GBV prevalence, particularly among primary school-aged children

gen_risks.description: Disability and inclusion challenges in the education sector
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure that newly constructed school buildings adhere to universal design principles and provide accessible learning environments

gen_risks.description: Climate change impacts on education infrastructure and continuity
gen_risks.mitigation: Integrate climate change considerations into project design, including climate-resilient infrastructure and remote learning capabilities

gt_risks.description: Environment and Social risk is rated Substantial due to (a) limited institutional capacity to manage environmental and social risks and impacts; (b) nationwide implementation of the project's activities; (c) possible exclusion of vulnerable groups (such as poor children, children with disabilities, and indigenous groups); and (d) other risks involving child protection, occupational health and safety, labor issues, and sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (SEA/SH).
gt_risks.mitigation: The project will develop a capacity-building plan for the Environmental and Social Safeguards Office and Project Management Unit, including hiring dedicated environmental and social specialists and providing targeted training. It will establish robust monitoring mechanisms to ensure support for vulnerable groups (universal design in new school/WASH construction, materials adapted for visually impaired students), strict adherence to worker codes of conduct, complaint redress and referral mechanisms, and construction site safety measures to protect school children and communities from labor influx and construction-related risks.
